title: com.docker.sandbox/agent-sessions@1
description: The workload's session control surface: the argv shapes a harness uses to drive the agent. prompt, resume, and continue are argv tails appended to the launch command; list is a complete command whose stdout enumerates resumable session ids, one per line, most recent first. Every verb is optional, but at least one must be declared.

prompt.description: Argv tail that runs one prompt non-interactively; must reference {{.Prompt}}, which the host substitutes before execution.

resume.description: Argv tail that reopens a named session; must reference {{.SessionID}}.

continue.description: Argv tail that reopens the most recent session.

list.description: Complete command (string run via sh -c, or argv list) whose stdout is one resumable session id per line, most recent first.
